companies.name: Kurly
companies.description: Kurly (컬리, operated by The Farmers Front) is a South Korean online grocery and lifestyle commerce company, known for Market Kurly and its overnight "dawn delivery" (샛별배송) model built on a cold-chain fulfillment network. Kurly Logistics Services (KLS) opens that network to contracted shipper clients (화주사) as a B2B Open API spanning three service families: fulfillment (물류대행), where Kurly holds and ships the shipper's stock, covering goods master, inbound receiving, inventory and ledgers, outbound orders and fulfillment plans; delivery agency (배송대행), where the shipper ships from their own warehouse over Kurly's Nextmile last-mile network; and shared delivery tracking. Access is contract-gated — clientId and secretKey are issued only after IP allowlist registration — and Kurly states as policy that KLS does not push data to external systems, so integrations poll rather than subscribe to webhooks.

bands.label: Thin

companies.name: Bithumb
companies.description: Bithumb is South Korea's leading cryptocurrency exchange platform offering REST and WebSocket APIs for spot trading across KRW, BTC, and USDT markets. The APIs cover market data, order management, account management, deposit and withdrawal operations, and real-time streaming for 396+ cryptocurrencies.

companies.name: Yonsei University
companies.description: Yonsei University is a private research university in Seoul, South Korea, founded in 1885 and ranked #73 in the QS World University Rankings 2025. Its public, machine-readable footprint is limited and primarily research- and library-oriented: the Yonsei Research Information portal runs on Elsevier Pure (which exposes Pure OAI-PMH and REST endpoints, but they require credentials/IP allow-listing and return HTTP 401 publicly), and the medical library operates a DSpace 5.5 institutional repository (YUHSpace) whose RSS feed is publicly reachable while its OAI-PMH/REST paths are not currently resolvable. No official, documented public developer portal or open API was confirmed; the only related GitHub presence is a student-run Google Developer Group (gdg-yonsei), not an official institutional API organization.

companies.name: Payple
companies.description: Payple (페이플) is a South Korean payment gateway (PG) and fintech provider that lets merchants accept online payments across domestic and international cards, real-time bank-account payments, recurring / billing-key charges, link payments, identity verification, and settlement / payout (Hub) services. Integration is offered through a hosted payment window initialized in the browser with a public client key, plus a server-side REST API (v2) authorized with partner credentials (PCD_CST_ID / PCD_CUST_KEY). Payple is a registered Korean electronic financial business with an Innovative Financial Service (혁신금융서비스) designation, and it publishes official language sample source, policy documents, and a developer center. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from the Payple developer center and the PAYPLECORP GitHub organization.

companies.name: Mindlogic
companies.description: Mindlogic is a South Korean generative-AI company whose products include FactChat (a multi-LLM enterprise chat platform with Studio chatbot building, deep research, meeting notes, and image/video generation), Bliss (a persona chatbot that learns a person's voice and personality for fan engagement), and Informe (a multilingual document-grounded website chatbot). For developers, Mindlogic operates the FactChat API Gateway — a unified, OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM proxy that fronts models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, xAI and Perplexity behind a single API key, metered in credits, with chat completions, an OpenAI Responses pass-through, an Anthropic Messages pass-through, text-to-speech, and image/video generation.

companies.name: Kakao
companies.description: Kakao Corp. is the South Korean technology group behind KakaoTalk — the dominant mobile messenger in Korea — along with KakaoPay (payments), Kakao Bank (digital bank), KakaoMobility (taxi, navigation, parking), KakaoMap, Kakao Games, Kakao Entertainment (Melon, Kakao Webtoon, Daum), and KakaoCloud. Kakao runs its public developer platform at developers.kakao.com, exposing REST APIs for Kakao Login (OAuth 2.0), Kakao Sync, KakaoTalk Share / Message / Friend Picker / Channel, KakaoStory, KakaoNavi, KakaoMap, Local search, Daum Search, KakaoPay (PG / online easy-pay), and KoGPT generative AI. KakaoMobility and Kakao Enterprise / KakaoCloud each operate additional partner- facing developer surfaces.

companies.name: My Real Trip
companies.description: My Real Trip (마이리얼트립) is South Korea's largest online travel platform, founded in 2012, selling flights, stays, tours, tickets, and activities across 680+ cities in 80+ countries to roughly 5 million monthly active users. For developers it publishes a Partner API (partner-ext-api.myrealtrip.com) that lets marketing/affiliate partners search products, generate trackable MyLink short links, and pull revenue and reservation reports, secured with a Bearer API key. It also operates an official public Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes real-time flight, stay, and tour/activity search to AI assistants such as Claude, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.

companies.name: Toss
companies.description: Toss is a Korean financial super-app operated by Viva Republica that provides REST APIs for payments, banking, credit scoring, identity verification, and financial services across the Toss ecosystem. The Toss Payments platform supports card payments, virtual accounts, mobile phone billing, bank transfers, and digital wallets including TossPay, KakaoPay, NaverPay, and SamsungPay, serving over 30 million registered users across South Korea.

companies.name: Coupang
companies.description: Coupang is a South Korean e-commerce company offering rapid delivery of a wide range of products including groceries, electronics, fashion, and household goods through its mobile app and website. Coupang exposes an Open API platform for marketplace sellers (vendors) to integrate product catalog, order, return, cancellation, settlement, and inquiry workflows.

companies.name: Hanyang University
companies.description: Hanyang University is a private research university in Seoul and Ansan, South Korea, ranked #162 in the QS World University Rankings 2025. It operates an official API Developer Center at api.hanyang.ac.kr that publishes REST-style Open APIs returning XML or JSON, with OAuth-based authentication, Android and iOS SDKs, an API testing console, and a developer community. Access to the Open APIs requires developer registration and authentication through the university's HY-in portal; individual endpoints and personal-data ("Private") APIs are gated behind that login, so they are not publicly enumerable.

companies.name: KakaoBank
companies.description: KakaoBank is South Korea's leading internet-only bank, offering REST APIs for account management, fund transfers, loans, credit scoring, and open banking data connectivity for the Korean market. Founded in 2016 and backed by Kakao Corp., KakaoBank serves over 26 million customers through a fully mobile and API-first digital banking platform.

companies.name: Pohang University of Science and Technology
companies.description: Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH) is a private research university in Pohang, South Korea, founded in 1986 by the steelmaker POSCO and ranked #87 in the QS World University Rankings 2025. POSTECH operates a public English-language website and a range of authenticated institutional systems (PODIUM portal, PLMS learning management, admissions, and certificate services). Its primary confirmed public, machine-readable API surface is the POSTECH Library OASIS institutional repository, a DSpace platform that exposes a live OAI-PMH 2.0 metadata-harvesting endpoint. No general-purpose developer portal or open-data API program was found; most other systems are login-gated.

companies.name: Seoul National University
companies.description: Seoul National University (SNU) is South Korea's flagship national research university, located in Seoul, and is ranked #34 in the QS World University Rankings 2025. Its primary public, machine-readable developer footprint is S-Space, the SNU Open Repository and Archive, a DSpace-based institutional repository that exposes a standards-compliant OAI-PMH 2.0 interface for metadata harvesting of theses, journal articles, and research outputs. SNU does not publish a centralized developer portal or general-purpose open-data API; most other digital services (mySNU portal, SSO, library discovery) are gated and not openly documented.

companies.name: Naver
companies.description: Naver Corp. is South Korea's largest internet company, operating the Naver search portal, Naver Webtoon, Naver Pay, Naver Maps, Naver Shopping, WORKS Mobile, and the LINE messenger platform (jointly with SoftBank via LY Corporation). Naver runs two distinct public developer surfaces: Naver Developers (developers.naver.com) which hosts Naver's classic Open APIs — Search (blog, news, book, encyclopedia, café, knowledge, web, image, shop, doc), Papago N2MT translation, Naver Login (OAuth 2.0), Naver Maps geocoding and static map, Datalab trend, CAPTCHA, and SmartEditor; and Naver Cloud Platform (www.ncloud.com) — Naver's IaaS / PaaS offering with Compute (Server, Container, Functions), Storage (Object, Block, File), Network (VPC, CDN+, Global Edge), AI (CLOVA Speech, CLOVA OCR, Papago, HyperCLOVA X), Maps, SENS (SMS / push messaging), Cloud Search, and Certificate Manager.

companies.name: Sungkyunkwan University
companies.description: Sungkyunkwan University (SKKU) is a private research university in Seoul and Suwon, South Korea, with roots dating to 1398, and is ranked #123 in the QS World University Rankings 2025. Its digital footprint centers on the Kingo Portal single sign-on environment, the iCampus learning system, the university library, and the KINGO-M mobile app. As of this review SKKU publishes no public, documented developer API or open-data portal; integration and identity services (Kingo SSO, eduroam) are gated to enrolled students, faculty, and staff. Public software activity exists mainly through research-lab and student developer-community GitHub organizations rather than a central institutional developer program.

companies.name: Simpatico Project
companies.description: Simpatico Project (유쾌한프로젝트, Yukwaehan Project Co., Ltd.) is a Korean B2B mental-wellness startup, backed by 500 Global, whose product Clify (클라이피, "Climb & Clarify") is an AI-based integrated mental-care and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) solution for individuals and companies. Clify uses a patented multimodal algorithm to fuse Face & Voice biosignals — blood-flow changes, micro-expressions and voice characteristics — into a roughly one-minute mental-state diagnosis (stress, anxiety, depression, burnout) that it claims exceeds 90% accuracy, and rolls the results up into an organization insight dashboard for HR (company-wide mental trends, high/low-risk teams, usage). Personal mental data is processed on-device and de-identified so it is never shared with the employer, and the company states it holds ISO 27001. Product surfaces include FAV (the Face & Voice AI diagnosis engine), an EAP counseling center, and the Clify organization-insight analytics. The public presence (clify.co.kr, an imweb-built marketing and account site) exposes no developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or webhook surface at this time.

Newneek is a consumer content brand rather than an API producer: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface. It appears in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company, and this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture. companies.name: Comento
companies.description: Comento is a South Korean career development and mentoring platform based in Seoul that connects job seekers with working professionals. The service offers a Q&A community and timeline for career discussions, free unlimited mentoring questions answered by industry practitioners, resume and cover letter (자기소개서) review, an AI resume analyzer, interview preparation, and job-focused educational programs including bootcamps (직무부트캠프) and classes for the Korean job market. It also runs corporate training and university affiliation partnerships. Comento operates as a consumer-facing web platform and does not publish a public developer API or documentation surface; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched with the domain and identity signals that are publicly observable.

companies.name: Finda
companies.description: Finda (핀다) is a South Korean fintech company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Seoul that operates a licensed online loan-comparison and financial-product marketplace. Through its mobile app and website, Finda lets consumers compare loan products from 76+ financial institutions and 400+ products in about a minute, refinance existing loans ("갈아타기"), aggregate accounts and cards for asset management, run financial calculators (interest, DSR, year-end tax, mortgage eligibility), and monitor and manage their credit. Registered as a loan-brokerage/loan-collection corporation under Korea's Financial Services Act, Finda earns commissions from partner financial institutions rather than charging consumers. It reports 3.47M+ cumulative members and 256T+ won in managed loan assets, and is backed by 500 Global. Finda is a consumer B2C platform and does not publish a public developer API.

companies.name: lunchlab Corp.
companies.description: lunchlab Corp. (런치랩) is a Seoul-based corporate lunch subscription and delivery service that brings daily meals to office teams across South Korea. It offers two rotating meal lines — a traditional home-style Korean lunch box and a "Fresh Meal" line of poke bowls and sandwiches — with delivery and pickup included for a flat per-meal price, employees choosing their meals through a mobile app while administrators manage orders and billing from a web dashboard. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network, lunchlab operates in the food-service / corporate-catering space and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs.

Repercent buys used smartphones and mobile devices — iPhone, Galaxy, tablets, and laptops — from individual sellers, providing instant online price quotes, fast payment, and a simple pickup/logistics flow for secondhand device trade-in. The company is a 500 Global portfolio company and was surfaced into the network as a venture portfolio lead. companies.name: Veluga
companies.description: Veluga (Veluga Brewery Inc.) is a South Korean B2B alcohol wholesale distribution platform that connects hospitality business owners with liquor suppliers. Operating from Mapo, Seoul, the company runs a wholesale marketplace offering real-time wholesale pricing quotes for spirits and craft beverages, product recommendations for business owners, wholesale order facilitation, and partnership programs for distributors and catering services. Veluga positions itself as a transaction and information intermediary rather than a direct seller. The company began as a craft-beer and snack subscription service and is backed by 500 Global, Kakao Ventures, SparkLabs, HL Holdings, and Sema Investment. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published; this profile captures the company identity for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: BAYCON
companies.description: BAYCON Inc. is a Seoul, South Korea-based mobile connectivity company, founded in 2018 and backed by 500 Global and Shorooq Partners (seed round, 2024). BAYCON operates a global data eSIM platform and a family of international communication apps: eSIM Easy (이심이지), which delivers multi-country data eSIM plans as a QR code within minutes of purchase; ModuCall (모두의 국제전화), affordable VoIP international calling that lets users place overseas calls using their domestic mobile plans; and BayTalk. The company partners with local network operators and global carrier infrastructure so international travelers and businesses can access local mobile networks without physical SIM cards, cut roaming costs, and stay connected across borders, and is expanding into travel content such as attraction tickets and transportation passes. BAYCON publishes consumer mobile apps rather than a public developer API surface.

companies.name: Woowa Brothers
companies.description: Woowa Brothers is the Seoul-based technology company behind Baedal Minjok (Baemin), South Korea's leading food delivery platform, alongside B-Mart quick commerce, Baemin Connect rider services, and robotics initiatives for serving and delivery robots. A subsidiary of Delivery Hero since 2021, the company runs a strong engineering culture through its Woowahan tech blog and first-party open-source libraries on GitHub (NestJS libraries, WoowahanJS, Redis tooling), but it does not publish a public developer API or developer portal.

companies.name: Habitus Associates Co., Ltd.
companies.description: Habitus Associates Co., Ltd. is the company behind Artue (artue.io), an AI-powered online marketplace for original artworks by Korean and international artists. Artue lets collectors discover, purchase, and resell paintings, photography, sculptures, and prints, with natural-language search that finds works by mood, color, style, room type, or budget. The platform is explicitly agent-native: it publishes an llms.txt and ships a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT can search its collection directly. Backed by 500 Global and surfaced into the API Evangelist network from that portfolio.

companies.name: H2O Hospitality
companies.description: H2O Hospitality is a South Korea-based hospitality digital-transformation company that connects existing hotel and leisure systems rather than replacing them, streamlining operations from booking to checkout. Its products span three areas: Connect (cloud property-management tooling including Smart CRS, Smart RMS, and Smart FMS), Maximize (revenue and guest-engagement tools such as Smart D2C and AI-based CRM), and Transform (managed operations). It offers smart mobile check-in and automated inventory management, operates across nine countries in Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East, and is ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 certified. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

companies.name: GeoGrid
companies.description: Geogrid Co., Ltd. is a South Korean smart-building water technology company behind BLOS ("Building Oasis"), an integrated building-level water purification and monitoring system. BLOS delivers drinkable water from every tap using chemical-free ionization to eliminate rust, scale, and biofilm, and pairs it with real-time monitoring of water quality, usage, carbon emissions, and consumption plus predictive analytics for pipe condition, contamination risk, and filter replacement. Geogrid targets schools, hotels and resorts, public institutions, and healthcare facilities, and offers a BLOS Care membership service. The company is based at Seoul Startup Hub Seongsu, holds 21 registered patents, and has been recognized with venture certification, ESG awards, and selection as a Korean representative for WSA 2026. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public website.

companies.name: PeopleFund, Perfect Technologies
companies.description: PFC Technologies (formerly PeopleFund) is a Seoul, South Korea fintech company operating at the intersection of direct online lending and AI lending infrastructure. It runs two platforms: CPLE (Crople), an online investment-linked finance (온라인투자연계금융) service that matches retail investors with consumer and small-business loans, and AIRPACK, an AI-powered, no-code underwriting and loan operations infrastructure (AIRPACK-Lab for data analysis, model development and approval-rule tuning, and AIRPACK-Studio for model deployment, rule-set operation and performance monitoring) sold to savings banks and other lending institutions. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDK, or partner API surface; AIRPACK integrations are handled through a direct sales/contact process. This record was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched as an API Evangelist network company profile.

Headquartered in Seoul with an R&D center in Suwon, the company is a 500 Global portfolio company. It is a materials/biotech manufacturer and does not currently publish a developer API, documentation, or developer portal; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

PlayCurio is consumer- and partnership-facing and publishes no developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation. Surfaced via the 500 Global portfolio and enriched here; a domain-security probe of play-curio.com is the only technical artifact this pass produced.

It is a native iOS and Android app; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

Through the Medb mobile app, patients receive 100% video consultations with physicians and have their prescribed medications delivered to their door — often within roughly 30 minutes to two hours — with no separate service fee beyond the standard consultation charge. Medir is a portfolio company backed by 500 Global. The business operates as a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network pending any future API surface.
